description: Unified spatial editor: a typed SelectionKind read-model over the existing (codified-non-merge) selection authorities, object-type-aware left-click operation dispatch, gimbal on path/vertex/segment selection (QA bug), and path-delete cascading to stamped glTF objects (QA bug) — plus a Cities-Skylines-map-editor-inspired terrain editor whose edits are NON-destructive PROPOSED overlays separate from true terrain, reportable on real scale/geometry (extent, area, cut/fill volume, slope, bearing)
notes: User-directed 2026-07-18 (same message that ratified p2p D-73..D-78). Two QA bugs land first (Phase 0): FR-3 gimbal-on-path (gimbal reads only NodeManager.selected + double-gated off in Select/Pen; path vertices/segments live in PathEditorState and never populate it) and FR-4 path-delete cascade-stamp (back-ref PathAssetInstance.source_track_id ALREADY exists; DbResult::NodeDeleted just never invalidates PathAssetCache, so stamps orphan AND resurrect on petal re-entry; both invalidate() methods already exist). Then FR-1 typed SelectionKind read-model (FACADE over NodeManager.selected + PathEditorState — do NOT merge storage; split codified in code_styleguides/ui_ux.md §5) + FR-2 object-type-aware left-click op table. Then FR-5 analytics-first proposed-overlay terrain editor: terrain is load-and-display-only today (literal placeholder in tool_panel.rs:601-613); edits become PROPOSED overlays via a new MapLayer parallel to the display-overlay LayerStack, NEVER writing TerrainHeightField/tileset (NFR-1 analytics contract). FR-6 wires the tested-but-unwired ruler.rs geometry math (polygon_area_m2/world_to_real_distance/bearing_deg) into a scale/geometry report panel. CONSUMES p2p_asset_streaming's mesh budget + D-78 AppSettings; coordinates left-click dispatch with road_builder_ux and measurement scope with hexon_scale_orchestration Phase 5. Ground-truth file:line evidence captured in the 2026-07-18 exploration sweep (spec Ground-truth section).
